race.description: Tab One Pool Fillies & Mares Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: ICYMISS (8) is ticking along nicely, with a narrow Warwick third as odds-on favourite following a close Sunshine Coast second on soft ground. She does rise from country company, but the form is current, she has handled wet tracks well and her record with Boris Thornton strengthens the case. ADORA DJON'S (10) is lightly raced and returned a maiden winner at Beaudesert, doing enough late as odds-on favourite. Has enough dash to offset the wide alley and should give backers another bold sight. CAXTON LASS (1) drops back from stronger benchmark racing and boasts a strong record here. Is better suited returning to 1200m. THRASH A BULLY (2) has been safely held at big prices, but the drop from NMW grade and the apprentice claim give her a platform to run into a minor placing. SHAPIN POWER (7) made an encouraging return on the Poly but went amiss here last time. Has been freshened with a month between to try and get him back on track.
